title: Caffeine
description: Documented ergogenic aid: Caffeine. The most studied legal performance enhancer: improves alertness, reaction time, endurance performance, and perceived effort across many sports.

title: Creatine monohydrate
description: Documented ergogenic aid: Creatine monohydrate. Raises muscle phosphocreatine stores, improving short-burst power, sprint repeatability, and strength gains when combined with resistance training.

title: Beta-alanine
description: Documented ergogenic aid: Beta-alanine. Buffers acid in working muscles, delaying fatigue in efforts lasting 1-4 minutes - rowing, swimming sprints, combat rounds.

title: L-citrulline
description: Documented ergogenic aid: L-citrulline. Boosts nitric oxide, widening blood vessels: improves high-intensity endurance, reduces soreness, and supports the muscle 'pump'.

title: Dietary nitrate (beetroot juice)
description: Documented ergogenic aid: Dietary nitrate (beetroot juice). Lowers the oxygen cost of exercise, improving time-trial and endurance performance, especially in recreational athletes.

title: Sodium bicarbonate (baking soda)
description: Documented ergogenic aid: Sodium bicarbonate (baking soda). Buffers blood acidity during all-out efforts of 1-7 minutes - track sprints, swimming, rowing, combat sports.

title: Whey protein
description: Documented ergogenic aid: Whey protein. Fast-digesting complete protein supporting muscle repair and growth after resistance training.

title: Casein protein
description: Documented ergogenic aid: Casein protein. Slow-digesting protein that feeds muscles overnight; supports recovery and reduces muscle breakdown during sleep.

title: Taurine
description: Documented ergogenic aid: Taurine. Supports cellular hydration and calcium handling in muscle; modest endurance and reduced muscle-damage signals in studies.

title: L-tyrosine
description: Documented ergogenic aid: L-tyrosine. Precursor to dopamine and norepinephrine; helps maintain focus and decision-making under stress, sleep loss, or cold.

title: Ashwagandha (Withania somnifera)
description: Documented ergogenic aid: Ashwagandha (Withania somnifera). May improve strength, muscle size, testosterone levels, stress hormones, and sleep quality in training adults.

title: Rhodiola rosea
description: Documented ergogenic aid: Rhodiola rosea. May reduce perceived exertion and fatigue and support endurance under stress.

title: Beta-hydroxy-beta-methylbutyrate (HMB)
description: Documented ergogenic aid: Beta-hydroxy-beta-methylbutyrate (HMB). May reduce muscle breakdown during intense training blocks and support strength in beginners and older adults.

title: Fish oil (omega-3 EPA/DHA)
description: Documented ergogenic aid: Fish oil (omega-3 EPA/DHA). May reduce exercise-induced muscle soreness and support joint, heart, and brain health in athletes.

title: Vitamin D3 (for athletes)
description: Documented ergogenic aid: Vitamin D3 (for athletes). Adequate vitamin D supports muscle function, bone health, immunity, and possibly reduced stress-fracture risk.

title: Iron (for deficient athletes)
description: Documented ergogenic aid: Iron (for deficient athletes). Restores oxygen-carrying capacity and endurance in iron-deficient athletes, especially female endurance runners.

title: Magnesium
description: Documented ergogenic aid: Magnesium. Supports muscle relaxation, sleep quality, and energy metabolism; many athletes fall short of intake.

title: Carbohydrate gels and drinks
description: Documented ergogenic aid: Carbohydrate gels and drinks. The foundational endurance enhancer: maintains blood sugar and spares muscle glycogen in long events.

title: Electrolyte drinks
description: Documented ergogenic aid: Electrolyte drinks. Maintains hydration and blood sodium, preventing cramps and dangerous hyponatremia in endurance events.

title: Tart cherry juice
description: Documented ergogenic aid: Tart cherry juice. May reduce muscle soreness and improve sleep quality via natural melatonin and anti-inflammatory compounds.

title: Curcumin (turmeric extract)
description: Documented ergogenic aid: Curcumin (turmeric extract). May reduce exercise-induced inflammation and soreness; studied in athletes and arthritis.

title: Coenzyme Q10 (CoQ10)
description: Documented ergogenic aid: Coenzyme Q10 (CoQ10). Supports mitochondrial energy production; may reduce statin-related muscle symptoms and support heart function.

title: L-carnitine
description: Documented ergogenic aid: L-carnitine. Shuttles fatty acids into mitochondria; may modestly support recovery and fat metabolism with chronic use.

title: Alpha-GPC
description: Documented ergogenic aid: Alpha-GPC. Choline donor that may support power output and focus; studied in resistance exercise.

title: Betaine (trimethylglycine)
description: Documented ergogenic aid: Betaine (trimethylglycine). May support power output and cellular hydration during resistance training.

title: Collagen peptides
description: Documented ergogenic aid: Collagen peptides. May support tendon and joint health and reduce joint pain in athletes.

title: Ginseng (Panax)
description: Documented ergogenic aid: Ginseng (Panax). Traditionally used for stamina and fatigue resistance; modest modern evidence.

title: Cordyceps (fungal)
description: Documented ergogenic aid: Cordyceps (fungal). Traditionally used for stamina; early studies suggest possible oxygen-utilization benefits.
